data.one_liner: A versatile Flutter color picker with customization options.
data.what_it_does: Provides customizable color picker widgets including a standard Color Picker, Hue Ring Picker, and Slider Picker. It supports features like alpha sliders, history colors, color models (HSV, HSL, RGB), and custom input bars.
use_when: You need to allow users to select colors in your Flutter application.
You require specific picker variants like hue rings or slider-based pickers.
You want customization over color picker borders, sliders, and input bars.
avoid_when: You are not building a user interface that requires color selection.
You require advanced non-color picker related widgets.
strengths: Multiple picker types (Color Picker, Hue Ring Picker, Slider Picker).
Extensive customization parameters for layout, borders, and input bars.
Supports alpha sliders and color history builders.
weaknesses: Documentation relies mostly on parameter listings rather than detailed guides.
